name: น้ำมา Rescue Map
idea: Reads flood help posts from Facebook and X, geolocates them and dispatches nearby volunteers with supplies.
twist: Parses Thai posts with landmarks like 'ซอยหลังวัด' and lets ShopeeFood riders opt in as dry-route supply runners.
sources: MySelamat (Great Malaysia AI Hackathon 2025, Champion) — AI flood-response system that combines real-time crowdsourced social media data with AI rescue route planning via Google Maps to coordinate rescuers, victims and authorities.
D-MIND (Super AI Engineer Season 5 2025, Thailand, AI Innovation Award) — Intelligent disaster monitoring and alert system built with AI.

name: ดูแลใจ Care Match
idea: Helps care managers match bed-bound elders with home caregivers by needs, skills, distance and family budget.
twist: Reads Thai long-term-care assessment forms and plans weekly visits for village caregivers (CG) across a tambon.
sources: Baan Oon Jai (AFTERKLASS Business KAMP 2025: Youth for Good (KBank), Thailand, 1st) — AI that supports child-welfare officers in assessing and matching children with suitable adoptive or foster families.

name: โอนช้าๆ
idea: Before an elder sends a large ShopeePay transfer, AI reads the context and asks a family member in LINE to confirm.
twist: Recognises Thai scam scripts like fake DSI or parcel-customs calls and explains the risk in kind, plain language.
sources: WaiJai (AFTERKLASS Business KAMP 2025: Youth for Good (KBank), Thailand, 2nd) — AI platform that analyses scam risk across channels to protect elderly people and reassure their caregivers.

name: 7 วันอันตราย Triage
idea: Guides bystanders through triage and first aid at multi-victim road crashes until the ambulance arrives.
twist: Built for Songkran and New Year crashes; streams triage tags and location to 1669 dispatchers.
sources: Rescue Master - Citizen Edition v2.0 (Cloud Intelligence Rising: Taiwan Generative AI Application Hackathon 2025 (DIGITIMES x AWS), 1st) — Disaster app that guides untrained citizens through START triage and basic first aid during mass-casualty events.

name: บิลลายมือ Order Desk
idea: Reads distributor orders from LINE photos of handwritten slips and voice notes and enters them into stock software.
twist: Reads messy Thai handwriting with shop nicknames; staff only confirm uncertain lines.
sources: CAIRGO (Microsoft Agentic AI Hackathon 2025 (Microsoft Taiwan x MODA), Taiwan, 1st) — China Airlines cargo agent that reads emailed booking orders and Excel/PDF attachments and enters bookings into the system so staff only verify them.

name: ป้าสั่งได้
idea: Elders shop on Shopee by speaking; the agent picks products and asks a family member to approve payment.
twist: Understands dialect and vague requests like 'ยาหม่องอันเดิม' by checking past orders.
sources: Welli (OutSystems AI Agent Hackathon 2025 (Japan & Korea), Enterprise 1st) — Voice-based AI life-support app for seniors who face digital access barriers.

name: ลอตเตอรี่ Eyes
idea: A chest-mounted phone helps blind lottery vendors move through markets and confirm cash and PromptPay payments by voice.
twist: Identifies Thai banknotes and reads the payment confirmation screen aloud, so vendors can't be short-changed.
sources: Gemma Vision (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 1st place) — AI assistant for visually impaired people that processes chest-mounted phone camera visuals and responds to voice or controller commands.
Hanamo (OutSystems AI Agent Hackathon 2025 (Japan & Korea), MVP Award) — Mobility safety support app for people with visual impairments.

name: ER Pre-Arrival
idea: Families describe symptoms by LINE on the way to a community hospital and the ER gets a triage level before arrival.
twist: Uses the Thai MOPH ED triage levels and prepares a one-screen summary for the duty nurse.
sources: Triage (MSIT AI Challenge & Hackathon 2025, Korea, Excellence Award) — Conversational AI agent service that predicts emergency patient needs and improves emergency-care management efficiency.

Medtelligence (Healthcare Hackathon Bavaria 2025, 3rd place, Munich) — Dashboard giving physicians a quick overview of relevant patient data via AI-supported filters plus automated advance information to save consultation time.

name: คอนโดจริงไหม
idea: Checks Facebook condo rental posts for scam signs before a renter transfers a deposit.
twist: Reverse-searches listing photos across groups and asks the building's juristic office to verify the unit.
sources: ASGI (MSIT AI Challenge & Hackathon 2025, Korea, Hackathon Grand Prize) — Safe-contract service that detects jeonse (rental deposit) fraud risk using public data, AI and MCP.

name: Free Fire Gamble Hunter
idea: Detects illegal gambling ads spread through game chats, clan names and livestreams and maps the network behind them.
twist: Decodes Thai obfuscated spam like 'ส ล็ อ ต' and links it to accounts for Garena enforcement.
sources: Mule Observation Detection Engine (KrungsriUniVerse x KMITL Hackathon: Mule Hunt Challenge 2025, Thailand, 1st) — Detects mule bank accounts by analysing links between gambling and loan networks tied to account trading plus social data, to block risk networks at the source.

Project Zeus (C:\>DIR Global Agentic Regulator Hackathon 2026, Honorary Award, Cambridge UK) — Human-governed multi-agent honeybot system that detects investment fraud ads and gathers enforcement evidence.

name: เพชรพอดี · kids top-up coach
idea: A story-based game teaches teens to budget their Garena top-ups and pocket money, with a parent dashboard.
twist: Uses Free Fire diamond prices and real top-up history so lessons feel like the game, not a lecture.
sources: KancaKids (BI x OJK Hackathon 2025, Indonesia, Student 2nd) — AI-powered gamified, story-based financial literacy platform for children and teens with dashboards for parents and educators.

name: ทริปคุ้ม Insurance
basedOn: AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys)
idea: Reads flight and hotel booking screenshots and recommends travel cover that matches the actual trip activities.
twist: Spots risky Thai trip activities like Koh Tao diving or Japan ski days and explains exclusions in plain Thai.
sources: AI Insurance Chatbot Platform (Team Rep Monkeys) (SingHacks 2025 (Ancileo x MSIG Conversational Insurance Challenge), Singapore, 3rd) — Agentic conversational travel-insurance system that extracts trip details from documents, supports voice purchase and recommends plans by destination and activity.

name: ถุงยา Reconciler
idea: Photographs an elder's pills and drug bags from several hospitals and finds duplicates and dangerous combinations.
twist: Reads Thai hospital drug labels, prepares a list for the village health volunteer and flags generics with different brand names.
sources: PillSnap (SGHackItRX 2025 (Pharmaceutical Society of Singapore), 1st Runner-up) — AI tool that detects and identifies multiple pills from one photo to help pharmacists with medication reconciliation.

name: RoV Clip Finder
idea: Creators search Garena esports VODs in plain Thai, like 'clutch teamfight at baron', and get clip timestamps.
twist: Understands Thai caster commentary and slang, then cuts ready-to-post vertical highlights for Thai creators.
sources: OpenCubee (Ho Chi Minh City AI Challenge 2025, Vietnam, 1st (Division A)) — Virtual assistant system that retrieves videos and images from a large multimedia database using natural-language queries.

name: จอประสาทตา Screening Ops
idea: Schedules diabetic eye screening rounds, reads retinal photos and routes urgent cases to provincial eye clinics.
twist: Designed for รพ.สต. with one shared camera; plans which villages get screened each week.
sources: Retinal Scan Tracking App (AI International Hackathon 2025 (SIT KMUTT), Thailand, 2nd) — AI application that uses eye-scanning technology.
